verdict.rationale: A government tax and customs portal could plausibly publish official SDKs or client libraries for its services, so this axis applies. The evidence pack only covers citizen-facing portal features (notifications, registration and login, tax and customs service access) and contains nothing about SDKs, client libraries, or developer APIs. The llms.txt probe is about agent-oriented docs indexing, not SDKs, so it does not bear on this story.
